info.text:
Crypto yield is just like savings interest? Not even close.
Jan 2022: Celsius pitched yields up to 18%; the average savings account paid 0.06% (FDIC).
Voyager, Celsius and BlockFi all filed for bankruptcy in 2022. In Jan 2023 a judge ruled coins in Celsius Earn accounts belonged to Celsius; holders of about 600,000 Earn accounts became unsecured creditors.
FDIC insurance covers bank deposits, not crypto. The GENIUS Act, signed July 2025, will bar stablecoin issuers from paying interest or yield just for holding (in force by Jan 2027).
Sources: FDIC, US Bankruptcy Court SDNY, Bloomberg Law, GENIUS Act (P.L. 119-27).
News and education, not financial advice.
